title: Driving SLM 1-Line Command Code & Gate 4 Expected Codes Specification (v1.2)
description: Single source of truth for the Phase 1 in-driving 0.5B SLM 1-line command codes, OVR canonical parameter order and mappings to PersonalRoutingOverride, deterministic Japanese pre-filter dictionary, Safety Gate invariants, and Gate 4 scoring rules. Supersedes schema/slm-command-code.v1.json.

pending_offer.description: none = no pending offer and outside 5s undo window (pending_offer=false; YES/NO/CXL must resolve to NOOP / NO_PENDING_TARGET); avoid = active avoid-chip offer; override_preview = active override confirmation preview; undo_window = confirmed route change within 5s undo window (valid target for CXL only).

last_junction.description: Whether ManeuverHorizon.refs.last exists within 180 s and 1.5 km.

next_junction.description: Whether ManeuverHorizon.refs.next exists at ASR start time.

OVR.description: Propose a PersonalRoutingOverride (weights, detour tolerance, or soft junction avoidance). Empty OVR is disallowed by grammar. Never auto-reroutes without explicit user consent. Standalone jp=last does not change the route and records a profile_proposals entry for S12 post-drive review.

mg.description: Short ramp / side-road merge avoidance priority

dt.description: Detour cap policy selector (v1.2: T|S only; R removed). T multiplies DetourPolicy cap by tight_factor; S keeps the standard DetourPolicy cap.

jp.description: Recent or upcoming difficult junction reference resolved by Rust from ManeuverHorizon.refs (soft avoid_if_practical only).

CXL.description: Cancel a pending proposal or revert a route switch confirmed within the 5-second undo window. When pending_offer is none, expected behavior is NOOP (Rust rejects with NO_PENDING_TARGET).

WHY.description: Request route reason. SLM outputs classification token only; explanation text is generated deterministically by Kotlin templates from RouteComparison inside a safe P2 window.

BMK.description: Bookmark the active or most recent trip-mode history/POI item for post-drive review.

YES.description: Affirmative response to an active offer. Per ADR-0007, SLM YES never confirms a route change (re-confirmation prompt only); confirmation enters exclusively via Rust dictionary match (dict_norm) or user_tap. When pending_offer is none, expected behavior is NOOP (Rust rejects with NO_PENDING_TARGET).

NO.description: Reject an active route/avoid offer and keep the current route. When pending_offer is none, expected behavior is NOOP (Rust rejects with NO_PENDING_TARGET).

NOOP.description: Safe no-operation fallback for ambiguous, out-of-contract, prohibited, unintelligible, or no-pending-target utterances.

deterministic_prefilter.description: Exact normalized Japanese short phrases handled deterministically by Rust dictionary matching (asr_result{text_class: dict, dict_norm}, < 50 ms, works in Tier 0) without invoking the SLM. YES matched here is one of the two valid route confirmation entry points (alongside user_tap); when pending_offer is none, YES/NO/CXL are rejected with NO_PENDING_TARGET (effective NOOP). While P3 history commentary is speaking, context_scoped_matches.P3_STOP takes precedence for ['やめて', '止めて', 'とめて', 'ストップ'] to stop P3 (Expired, save_for_later=false) without triggering CXL; outside P3 speaking, 'やめて' resolves to exact_matches.CXL as before, while 'キャンセル' / '取り消し' / '取り消して' / '戻して' / '元に戻して' always resolve to CXL.

dispatch_rules.when_p3_speaking: ['やめて', '止めて', 'とめて', 'ストップ'] stop P3 history commentary only (POI -> Expired, save_for_later=false) and do not invoke CXL or other cancellations.
dispatch_rules.when_p3_not_speaking: 'やめて' resolves to exact_matches.CXL as before (rejected with NO_PENDING_TARGET / effective NOOP when pending_offer is none). '止めて', 'とめて', and 'ストップ' do not trigger P3_STOP or CXL outside P3 speaking.
dispatch_rules.always_cxl_rule: 'キャンセル', '取り消し', '取り消して', '戻して', and '元に戻して' always resolve to CXL and never stop P3 history commentary.
